title: Force kill an unresponsive process
summary: Send a SIGKILL signal to immediately stop a process that is not responding to normal termination requests.

steps.explain: Send the SIGKILL signal (-9) to the process ID. This forces the operating system to terminate the process immediately without giving it a chance to clean up.

placeholders.name: PROCESS_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the process to force kill

warnings: Force killing a process can lead to data loss or corrupted files if the program was in the middle of saving.
Use this only if the process does not respond to a normal kill signal.

rollback.explain: There is no direct rollback for a killed process. You must restart the application manually if needed.
